subject: Startups
title: Why Delaware
description: Learn Why Delaware in one minute.

hook.text: Over 60% of Fortune 500 companies are incorporated in Delaware. Not because they're there—almost none are.

buildup.text: Delaware's Court of Chancery handles business disputes with specialized judges. No juries.

discovery.text: Decades of case law make Delaware contracts and corporate governance the most well-understood in the country.

climax.text: Delaware's real product is legal certainty. For startups navigating complex equity deals, predictability is priceless.

punchline.text: Delaware sells legal certainty. The entire startup world buys it.

quiz.question: Why do most startups incorporate in Delaware?
options: Specialized courts and well-established corporate law
